plan.title: Knockout Auction Vendor Target Price Actions

steps.note: Start the RFQ that can be converted into a Knockout auction.
Create an RFQ-only project, which is the required source for a Knockout conversion.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding items.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite a vendor as required by the setup.
Publish the RFQ so it can be converted.
Confirm the RFQ reached a published project page.
Open the converted auction create screen, the supported route to Knockout auctions.

args.goal: On the converted auction create screen, select the Knockout strategy and complete any required Knockout configuration without inventing business values; stop when the converted auction is ready to publish

steps.note: Configure the Knockout strategy, which has no dedicated catalog step on the converted-auction screen.
Confirm the Knockout auction reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the published Knockout auction in the vendor portal.

args.need: inspect the vendor's Knockout auction screen and verify that the shown target price has only accept and reject actions

steps.note: No catalog assertion can read or exercise the Knockout vendor offer controls.
End with an observable assertion after the manual inspection point.
